data.body: GAP NOTE: _PLUGIN_ROOT is a module-level constant set at import time. CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT env var is read once at import, not per-call. For test isolation, do NOT use monkeypatch.setenv + cache_clear — the module won't re-read the env. Instead, use monkeypatch.setattr(dispatch_module, '_AGENTS_DIR', tmp_path / 'agents') to directly patch the resolved path. This avoids needing importlib.reload() and works cleanly with lru_cache (clear the cache after the setattr, then test). Update test_plugin_root_prefers_claude_plugin_root_env to verify _PLUGIN_ROOT is computed from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT at import time by setting env var BEFORE importing the dispatch module (use importlib.import_module in a subprocess or a module-level fixture that sets env before first import).
